# Build the NZULM/NZMT adapter and FHIR fixture boundary

**Parent:** https://github.com/edithatogo/global-medicines-atlas/issues/1  
**GitHub issue:** https://github.com/edithatogo/global-medicines-atlas/issues/3  
**Conductor phase:** Phase 2  
**Requirements:** M-010–M-014, M-020, M-022

## Acceptance criteria

- Canonical NZ source contracts validate.
- NZMT hierarchy and identifiers are preserved.
- Medsafe and PHARMAC assertions remain separate.
- FHIR projections retain source provenance.
- Deterministic fixtures cover valid, malformed, conflicting, and negative-control cases.
